Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A news article covering the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

args.body: Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your website (www.dora-website.com). I took a look at it — it's a nice personal site that clearly introduces you and gives people an easy way to reach you via email. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it even stronger: adding a short bio with a bit more personality, some photos or links to your projects, and a few recent posts or updates would help visitors get a fuller sense of who you are and what you're up to. Overall, it's a clean and welcoming introduction — nice work!

Hi Eve! Thanks for sharing your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I had a read through it — it's a lovely personal blog, and I love that you share your passion for hiking with readers. A few ideas to make it even more engaging: adding photos or maps from your hikes, writing up a few specific trail guides or trip recaps, and including a short "about me" intro would give visitors a stronger sense of who you are and where to go next. Overall, a warm and inviting blog — keep it up!
